newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Luk Fook says to offer 114 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Luk Fook says to offer 114 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Jewellery manufacturer and retailer Luk Fook Holdings (International) Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 114 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a proforma fully-diluted price/earnings multiple of 6.9 times and a weighted average multiple of 5.7 times.
The shares are offered with warrants in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares subscribed to.
The annual dividend yield is five percent and adjusted net tangible asset value per share is HK$0.677.
The IPO will run from April 22 to 25 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on May 6.
Citicorp International Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
Luk Fook currently operates 12 retail outlets in Hong Kong.

Of the net proceeds from the new issue of about HK$98 million, HK$60 million will be used to set up three additional retail shops in Hong Kong, HK$5 million to expand the company's manufacturing facilities, HK$20 million to repay a bank loan, and the balance for working capital.
The company forecasts a combined profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$60 million for the year ended on March 31, 1997.

Luk Fook said it recorded a profit of HK$46.5 million for the year ended in March 1996, up from HK$41.8 million in 1995 and HK$23.4 million in 1994. It posted a profit of HK$22.1 million for seven months period to October 1996.
